name: accordion
title: Accordion
description: A single column of collapsible question rows; clicking one rotates its chevron and slides the answer open while closing any other. The rest of the list stays compact.
use: You need a tidy FAQ or disclosure list where only one answer is relevant at a time.
avoid: Only one answer can stay open, so readers cannot compare several answers at once.
a11y: Headers are buttons with aria-expanded and labelled panels, but the spring motion ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Four dark rounded rows stacked with thin gaps on a near-black page, each with a left-aligned question and a chevron at its right. The open row is pale grey with a block of dark answer text beneath it; closed rows are darker with muted labels.
behaves: Clicking a row expands its answer with a spring height and a clip reveal, and the chevron flips to point up. Only one row is open at a time, so opening another closes the previous; hovering brightens a closed row.
customise: Questions and answers are written into the JSX per item; multiple and defaultValue on the root control whether one or many can open. Colours come from the shared row classes.
weight: light: Four rows and one spring height animation driven by a motion library.
